scope: Next five shortest canonical mechanics records after Batch 398

records.name: Sonic Bomb
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ105, where maintained current reward data places it in the Basic Reward pool. The attack launches a sonic shockwave/blast; older player reports conflict on reward tier, so no Ultimate-Finish-only gate is asserted.

records.name: Seagull Combination
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super. Performs a punch flurry followed by a powerful launching kick; additional Ki can extend the punch sequence, and an optional spinning-kick follow-up is unblockable. Current evidence keeps exact frame/damage breakdown bounded.

records.name: Death Crasher
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super. Chargeable fists-first rush whose longer charge increases reach and strength; current reference reports 20% damage. Exact charge-frame and hitbox data remain unresolved.

records.name: Fighting Pose F
records.mechanics_notes: 0-Ki Power Up Super granting Hyper Armor for 12 seconds. Incoming damage is redirected to Stamina rather than Health during the effect, while Stamina regeneration is greatly reduced; exact reduction values remain unresolved.

records.name: Super Dragon Flight
records.mechanics_notes: 300-Ki Strike Ultimate acquired from PQ31. Maintained PQ31 reward data places it in Basic Rewards rather than asserting an Ultimate-Finish-only gate; exact damage and frame details remain bounded.

validation.evidence_policy: bounded; no unsupported probabilities or frame data
